# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient entries, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Get the proportion of patients in each severity level within each arm
severity_counts = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
